editorial:
Imagine starting your first big job as a police officer and wanting to be the next great detective. That is exactly where you find PL Thomas, a guy who is obsessed with Sherlock Holmes and desperate to prove himself. He thinks he has found the perfect case to make his name, but there is one big problem: his wife. She is a total whirlwind who accidentally messes up his clues and ruins his hard work. It turns into a hilarious battle between his need for order and her chaotic energy, making the whole movie feel like a wild ride where everything that can go wrong actually does.

You will love how the movie balances the funny moments with the stress of a failing investigation. The acting is great, especially the way the lead actor shows his slow break from reality as things fall apart. While the plot gets a bit messy in the middle, the payoff is worth it.
endingExplained: After almost losing his mind, Thomas tries one last desperate plan to fix his reputation. He manages to solve the case not by being a genius, but through a series of lucky accidents and some help from the people around him. The big twist is that the culprit was hiding in plain sight all along. In the end, he gets the credit he wanted, but he learns that his chaotic home life is more important than being a perfect detective.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves clumsy heroes and funny family dynamics.
